summary: Tested Public PO Request feature - 14/14 backend API tests passed, frontend form submission and tracking page working after bug fix. Admin Requests tab shows pending requests with Edit & Assign functionality.

ui_bugs.issue: School name field validation bug - when user manually types (instead of selecting from autocomplete), the value was stored in schoolSearch but validation checked formData.school_name

issues: Vendor name shows as 'Order from' (empty) when no vendor assigned - this is expected behavior but could show 'Not Yet Assigned' for better UX

passed_tests: POST /api/public/po-request - Create PO request without authentication
POST /api/public/po-request - Validation rejects empty products
POST /api/public/po-request - Validation rejects empty requester name
GET /api/track/{token} - Track order by token returns correct data
GET /api/track/{token} - Invalid token returns 404
GET /api/purchase-orders?status=request - Admin can view request status POs
POST /api/purchase-orders/{id}/approve-request - Fails without vendor assignment
PUT /api/purchase-orders/{id} - Admin can edit request PO and assign vendor
PUT /api/purchase-orders/{id} - PO remains in 'request' status after edit
POST /api/purchase-orders/{id}/approve-request - Approves and changes status to 'sent'
GET /api/purchase-orders/{id} - Status changed to 'sent' after approval
GET /api/track/{token} - Shows updated status after approval
POST /api/purchase-orders/{id}/approve-request - Non-admin (vendor) correctly denied
UI: Public PO Request form loads correctly at /add
UI: All required form fields present (requester_name, school_name, delivery_address, contact_person, contact_number, delivery_date, products)
UI: Form submission works and redirects to tracking page
UI: Tracking page shows status timeline and order details
UI: Admin can login and navigate to Purchase Orders page
UI: Requests tab visible with pending count
UI: Requests table shows requester, school, products, vendor status
UI: Edit & Assign button visible for unassigned requests
UI: Edit page shows vendor dropdown, pricing fields, and Update button
seed_data_creation: Created test PO requests during tests (REQ-xxxx format), cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public PO Request feature fully functional. Key flows tested: 1) External user submits form at /add -> receives tracking token 2) Tracking page at /track/:token shows status 3) Admin sees requests in 'Requests' tab with 'Not Assigned' badge 4) Admin clicks 'Edit & Assign' to add vendor and pricing 5) Admin approves request which changes status to 'sent'. Bug fixed: school_name validation in PublicPORequest.js now uses schoolSearch as fallback.
